sections.overview: Manage branding and the core information members see first.
sections.events: Schedule community events and track who's going.
sections.structure: Reorder categories and channels in a simple list. Matches the order you see in the sidebar — handy on touch devices.
sections.roles: Review the role ladder, member distribution, and default permissions at a glance.
sections.emoji: Manage emoji and sticker packs for the composer picker.
sections.discord: Import channels and roles from Discord, refresh your layout, and optionally link live messages and voice activity.
sections.security: Configure verification gates and guest access for who can participate.
sections.access: Control who can discover and join this server, plus optional join applications and waitlist.
sections.tickets: Set up a ticket system so members can submit private reports and inquiries.
sections.selfAssignableRoles: Enable a built-in widget channel where members pick up self-selectable roles.
sections.automod: Define custom AutoMod rules—conditions and actions—that run in order after the built-in spam filter.
sections.moderation: Tune anti-raid protection, content filters, and built-in moderation defaults (spam filter, mentions).
sections.auditLog: Review administrative actions and moderation events across your server.
sections.bans: Review banned members, reasons, and moderation ownership.
sections.dangerZone: Perform high-risk administrative actions for ownership, archival, and deletion.
